This update introduces new functionality for spatial, multimodal, and scalable single-cell analysis. > > Seurat v5 is backwards-compatible with previous versions, so that users will continue to be able to re-run existing workflows. Installation instructions, documentation, and tutorials can be found at: Seurat can be successfully installed in R on any system (Mac OS X, Linux, Windows).
